item.title: White House to host Russian, Ukrainian representatives as U.S. mediates Abu Dhabi peace talks
item.description: The White House will bring Russian and Ukrainian representatives together this week for talks on the ceasefire in Ukraine's southern Kherson region, as Russia on Tuesday confirmed that U.S.-mediated peace negotiations between the two countries will take place in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10-11.

item.title: Child dies of measles in New York, seventh U.S. death this year as outbreaks spread
item.description: A child in rural northern New York has died after contracting measles, marking the state’s first death from the disease in 30 years, state officials announced Monday. item.title: FDA grants tentative approval to first generic HIV prevention shot
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted tentative approval to Dr. Reddy's Laboratories for the first generic version of lenacapavir, a groundbreaking twice-yearly injectable HIV prevention drug, just 16 months after the originator product was approved.
